Post 1 · publish 4th · the promise

NEVER WALK ALONE.

What Safer is — the homepage H1 as a poster, the orb as her companion.

Caption

Meet Safer. 💙 A personal safety app that watches over you when you're more exposed — and reaches your trusted people when you can't. Because being alone shouldn't mean being on your own. iPhone pilot is open — tap the link in bio for early access.

#PersonalSafety #SafetyApp #NeverWalkAlone #PeaceOfMind #WomenSafety #iOSApp #TrustedCircle
Post 2 · publish 3rd · use case

WALKING HOME? WATCH ME.

When you use it — the Watch Me session, the orb walking her home.

Caption

Heading out, or just feeling uneasy? Turn on Watch Me. Safer starts a smart monitoring session and watches over you — until you say you're safe. You're in control, always. Try it first — join the iPhone pilot via the link in bio.

#WatchMe #WalkingHome #GetHomeSafe #PersonalSafety #NightOut #SafetyFirst #PeaceOfMind
Post 3 · publish 2nd · the moment of need

ONE TAP. YOUR PEOPLE KNOW.

What happens when it matters — the set's only red, reassurance not fear.

Caption

When you need them, there's no time for group chats. One tap alerts your trusted people with your live location — and if the app can't reach them, WhatsApp and SMS will. The alert always lands. That's the point. Join the iPhone pilot — link in bio.

#SOS #EmergencyButton #LiveLocation #TrustedContacts #PersonalSafety #SafetyApp #OneTap
Post 4 · publish 1st · who it's for

YOUR WHOLE FAMILY, ONE CIRCLE.

The audience widener — the family-page H1, the orb joins the circle.

Caption

The walk to school. The bus home. Grandma's afternoon out. One circle of people who see each other's location — only when they choose to share it. Peace of mind, without hovering. Bring your circle to the iPhone pilot — link in bio.

#FamilySafety #KidsSafety #SchoolRun #FamilyCircle #PeaceOfMind #ParentingLife #SafetyApp

This post goes live first — so the bio link must already work when it does.

Post 6 · publish 5th · the consent value

SHARED ONLY WHEN YOU CHOOSE.

Answers the surveillance objection — the orb as the consent switch's knob.

Caption

Safer isn't about being watched. It's about being watched over — when you ask. You choose who sees your location, and when. Start a session when you want company; end it the moment you're home. Your location is yours. Join the iPhone pilot — link in bio.

#PrivacyFirst #YouChoose #LocationSharing #TrustedCircle #PersonalSafety #SafetyApp #PeaceOfMind
Post 5 · publish 6th (last) · use case

ON A RUN? NOT ALONE.

The last everyday use case from the site's value line — the orb pacing ahead as running partner.

Caption

Early morning, long route, headphones in — bring Safer along. Start Watch Me and go: Safer watches over your run until you say you're back. Just you, your pace, and someone who's got you. Runners, the iPhone pilot is open — link in bio.

#RunningSafety #RunnerSafety #MorningRun #WatchMe #WomenWhoRun #PersonalSafety #PeaceOfMind

Before publishing

Must happen first

  • Grab the @safer.global handle on Instagram (not yet claimed by us as of the last site audit).
  • Set the bio link to the pilot / early-access page (web.safer.global/pilot.html) — every caption ends on "link in bio", and Post 4 publishes first.
  • Profile photo: the orb on its blue tint (matches the site favicon world).
  • Bio line: "Personal safety for iPhone. Never walk alone. Pilot open ↓"

Cadence & what's next

  • Brand-new account: publish all six the same day — the profile is the landing page at pilot stage. Existing audience: space 1–2 days apart in the same order.
  • Order: 4 → 3 → 2 → 1 → 6 → 5, so the grid lands Run · Choose · Promise / Home · SOS · Family.
  • Next layer (advisor): reels with proof and engagement. A 7th tile breaks the designed 2×3 — plan its color/role and re-gate the grid first (3×3 is the next stable shape).
  • Spanish versions can reuse the site's existing EN→ES dictionary.

Process record — every stage gated by the social-media + brand watchers. Round 1 (posts 1–4): concept v1 rejected for an unbacked traction claim, then each tile rendered and individually approved on the real pixels. Round 2 (posts 5–6): concepts revised for claim drift, and Post 6's toggle failed the meaning-closure test at render, shipping with the pre-agreed fallback headline. Final six-thumbnail grid check passed by both watchers. Full reviews: ~/safer-instagram/review_social_v1.md · review_brand_v1.md · sources post1–4.html.
